name: Fate of Eivess
disable: DC 38 Society check (master) or DC 40 Religion check (master) to convince the spirits that their horror has been over for millennia, or DC 38 Occultism check (master) or DC 42 Intimidation check to recognize that this avatar exists only in the memories of the tormented spirits and command it to stand down; three total successes are required to disable the haunt
routine: (3 actions) The avatar uses its first action each round to Devour Faithful, then attempts to Strike and swallow a frightened creature within 20 feet. If no nearby creatures are frightened, the avatar continues using its actions to Devour Faithful until a frightened victim becomes available.

items.name: Massacre
items.text:
Trigger Eivess places the last of the eggs on the ground and calls for Yig to appear

---
Effect The towering serpent rises over the hill and snatches Eivess in its jaws, swallowing him whole and sparking mass panic among his followers, with the effects of Devour Faithful. The haunt rolls initiative.

items.name: Devour Faithful
items.text: The avatar of Yig seizes a nearby follower and gulps them down. The terrifying sight deals 3d10+15 mental damage to all creatures within 30 feet (DC 30 basic Will save save). Any creature that takes this mental damage is Frightened 1, or Frightened 2 on a critical failure.

items.name: Swallow Whole
items.text:
Huge, 3d10+15 mental, Rupture 40

A swallowed creature hurtles through a terrifying vortex of indistinct shadows, surrounded by the distant wails of swallowed pilgrims. They can't reduce their Frightened value below 1 until they escape or cut themselves free.

---

text: The restless spirits of the prophet Eivess and his followers force intruders to relive their deaths at the fangs of Yig's avatar.
